smarthud.config.title: SmartHUD Configuration
smarthud.config.slots.bothSides.tooltip: Distribute item slots across both the left and right sides of the hotbar
smarthud.config.slots.inventoryHudCompat: Automatically shift slots outward when Inventory HUD+ is installed so armor and status icons are not overlapped
smarthud.config.slots.inventoryHudOffset: Extra horizontal margin (in pixels) reserved on each side when Inventory HUD+ is active
smarthud.config.slots.offsetX.tooltip: Additional manual horizontal offset (in pixels) from the hotbar
smarthud.config.slots.empty.tooltip: Always draw a slot regardless of items present
smarthud.config.slots.includeEmpty.toolt: Always draw a slot regardless of items present
smarthud.config.slots.style.tooltip: The look and feel of the item slots
smarthud.config.slots.cumulative.tooltip: Merge similar items into the same slot
smarthud.config.slots.overlays.tooltip: Draw the item overlays, such as enchantment glints
smarthud.config.slots.size.tooltip: The maximum number of item slots to draw across the HUD
smarthud.config.slots.whitelist.tooltip: Enable the whitelist. If disabled, item slots will only show clocks and compasses
smarthud.config.whitelist.enabled.toolti: Enable the whitelist. If disabled, item slots will only show clocks and compasses
smarthud.config.ticker.duration.tooltip: The duration in milliseconds that items should be shown for
smarthud.config.ticker.style.tooltip: The look and feel of the item ticker
smarthud.config.ticker.size.tooltip: The maximum number of items to show at once
smarthud.config.ticker.behavior.tooltip: The behavior of the item ticker. 0: Sort by most recent pickup, 1: Sort by initial pickup
